name: cPanel / WHM
description: Creates, suspends and terminates cPanel accounts on a WHM server you add to the fleet, and opens a panel session without a password.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: How long to wait for WHM before giving up on a call.

config.label: Retries
config.hint: Bounded retries with backoff. Creating an account twice is safe: WHM's "account already exists" is read as success.
